nodes.label: Rail Texture
nodes.description: Minecraft-style rail (minecart track) texture. Two parallel horizontal grey metallic rails on a transparent background (rails are a non-full block/flat tile). Grey-silver rail tracks with perpendicular crossties or absent in the standard straight variant. Color palette: medium grey (#808080) rail color, off-white (#B0B0B0) highlights, transparent or black (#000000) background gaps between rails. Game purpose: flat track block placed on ground for minecarts to travel along; connects to form straight or curved paths; used for minecart transportation systems.
nodes.pattern: two parallel horizontal metallic strips (rails) with transparent/dark gaps between
